title: Ceres Search
description: Word search for XMAS in all directions and X-shaped MAS crosses.
writeup:
## Approach

A classic grid search problem with two different pattern types.

## Part 1

For every cell containing 'X', check all 8 directions (horizontal, vertical, diagonal) for the full word "XMAS". Bounds-check before reading 4 characters in each direction.

## Part 2

Look for X-shaped crosses where two diagonal "MAS" strings intersect at a shared 'A'. For each 'A' in the grid, check the two diagonals: top-left/bottom-right and top-right/bottom-left. Each must spell either "MS" or "SM" (i.e. one M and one S on each diagonal).
